manifest.token_expectation_origin: independent Unicode groupby plus pinned prefix and term positions
manifest.query_selection: deterministic fixed families; CF ties broken lexicographically; no measurement input

measurement_boundaries.query: prepared corpus -> raw query normalisation -> all materialised matches; block list included
measurement_boundaries.total: loaded raw corpus in memory -> prepare -> optional build -> Q identical complete profile queries; materialised results retained until post-timer validation
measurement_boundaries.load: cached local files, not cold disk
measurement_boundaries.gc: disabled only inside timer, previous state restored; gc.collect once per dataset
measurement_boundaries.cache: in-process warmed interpreter/allocator; no CPU isolation; no concurrent project benchmark/test/build
measurement_boundaries.memory: separate worker per dataset/index; tracer starts after preparation, no alternate production index built
